info.name: ShopVerse API
info.description:
Complete API collection for ShopVerse, a role-based e-commerce platform.

## Setup
1. Select the **ShopVerse Local** environment.
2. Run the **00 Setup** folder first — it logs in every role and discovers the product ids everything else needs.
3. Every other request inherits Bearer `{{token}}` from this collection.

## Folders
Folders 01–10 walk the full lifecycle in order. Folder **99 Negative Tests** proves the business rules are enforced — every request there expects a 4xx, and none returns 500.

exec: // The happy-path product must belong to seller 1, because folder 06 uses
// {{sellerToken}} (seller 1) to advance that order through its statuses.
// A seller may only touch orders containing their own products.
// Its price has to sit inside a band, or the coupon tests become non-deterministic:
//   >= 700   clears the WELCOME10 minimum (Rs.500), so the happy path applies
//   <= 4000  stays under the BIGONLY minimum (Rs.10000) even at quantity 2,
//            so the "minimum order not met" rejection actually rejects
const inBand = function (p) { return p.price >= 700 && p.price <= 4000; };
const healthy = items.find(function (p) { return p.stock > 15 && inBand(p) && ownedBySeller1(p); })
// A product at or below the low-stock threshold.
const low = items.find(function (p) { return p.stock > 0 && p.stock <= 8; });
